prompts.text: Name a river in Africa
Name a national park or game reserve in Africa
Name a country in Eastern Africa (UN regions; Zambia, Zimbabwe, Malawi and Mozambique count)
Name an African country that gained independence in 1960 (the 'Year of Africa')
Name a country or territory bordering Algeria, Libya or Egypt (Libya borders both of the others, so all three count)
Name a country bordering Senegal, Guinea or Mali (they all border each other, so all three count)
Name the capital of a country in Western Africa (UN regions; official capitals plus the seats of government Cotonou and Abidjan)
Name the capital of a country in Eastern Africa (UN regions; official capitals as of 2025)
Name the capital of a country in Northern, Central or Southern Africa (UN regions; all three South African capitals count)
Name an African country that was once ruled by France (colony, protectorate or mandate)
Name a port city in Africa
Name one of South Africa's nine provinces, or one of its three capital cities
Name a city or town in South Africa
Name a city or resort in Egypt
Name a city or resort in Morocco or Tunisia
Name a city or resort in Kenya or Tanzania
Name the capital of a country in East or South-East Asia (Taiwan's capital counts)
Name the capital of a country in South, Central or Western Asia (UN regions; Jerusalem as the capital Israel declares)
Name a currency used in Asia (national currencies; the base name is enough, like rupee)
Name a mountain range in Asia (ranges on the Europe-Asia boundary count)
Name a desert in Asia
Name an island of Indonesia or the Philippines
Name a river in Asia
Name a city, town or resort in Vietnam
Name a city, town or resort in Turkey
Name a city in Iran
Name a city, town or resort in Sri Lanka
Name a city or town in Cambodia, Laos or Myanmar
Name a city in a Gulf state (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain or Oman)
Name a European country that is not in the European Union (as of 2026)
Name a country that joined the European Union in 2004 or later
Name a country bordering Italy or Austria (they border each other, so both count)
Name a country bordering Poland, Ukraine or Belarus (they all border each other, so all three count)
Name a river in Europe
Name a mountain range in Europe
Name a volcano in Europe (Iceland and the Atlantic islands count)
Name a city in Denmark, Finland, Norway or Sweden
